entities.name: Kouvola–Iisalmi railway

entities.summary: The Savo railway is a five-foot-gauge railway in Finland. Beginning at Kouvola, it connects southern Finland with the eastern regions of South Savo and North Savo via the cities of Pieksämäki, Kuopio and Iisalmi.
